definitions.valid_transactions: Source-valid distinct orders with an ID, a parsed MM/DD/YYYY date, a true source-validity flag, positive sales, and INR currency, before plausibility filtering.
definitions.analysis_transactions: Source-valid distinct orders with a positive Order Value <= ₹7,500; this cleaned scope powers all project metrics.
definitions.gross_sales: Sum of positive INR Sales Amount for the plausibility-filtered analytical scope.
definitions.repeat_rate: Customers with at least two included analytical transactions in the filtered scope divided by active customers in that scope.
definitions.cohort_retention: Customers active at cohort age m divided by customers first observed in that acquisition month within the filtered scope.
definitions.average_transaction_value: Plausibility-filtered INR sales divided by included analytical transactions; not labelled AOV because the source grain is unverified.
definitions.median_transaction_value: Median Order Value among included analytical transactions in the filtered scope.
definitions.rating_coverage: Rows with a non-null Restaurant Rating divided by all source rows; this is an evidence-availability measure, not a quality score.
definitions.menu_coverage: Rows with a non-null Menu_Item_Count divided by all source rows; this is an evidence-availability measure, not a quality score.
